vision.paraphrase: A monthly summary of spending per category is the third goal.

conops.paraphrase: The user asks for a month and sees a total per category.

vision.paraphrase: The summary is monthly: other months must not leak into it.

conops.paraphrase: Only the requested month is totalled.

vision.paraphrase: A summary must be understandable even when there is nothing to show.

conops.paraphrase: A month with no transactions is reported in words.

vision.paraphrase: One date format everywhere, including what the user types.

conops.paraphrase: The month is given as YYYY-MM.

vision.paraphrase: Ten years of transactions must not make a report slow.

conops.paraphrase: With every transaction since the user started, the summary still appears without a noticeable wait.
